time_policy.method: same documented UTC daily averaging interval; no time interpolation
time_policy.time_offset_hours_definition: observation timestamp minus encoded model timestamp
time_policy.evidence: Copernicus PUM issue 1.7, section 2c Time averaging, printed page 9: daily means span midnight to midnight, centred at noon.

temperature_policy.limitation: Physical quantity/reference aligned by CF definition; exact model equation-of-state and temperature-scale conventions are not fully established by the supplied file. TEOS-10 conversion may differ slightly from model thermodynamics.

depth_policy: -gsw.z_from_p(PRES_ADJUSTED, latitude); positive down; dynamic-height and sea-surface-geopotential corrections omitted; no extrapolation
horizontal_policy: Haversine nearest cell with at least two finite valid temperature levels and a valid adjacent bracket for at least one eligible observation; distance cap 10 km. No interpolating across missing vertical gaps.
metrics_weighting: Unweighted across matched levels; not depth-thickness-weighted; samples are vertically correlated.
